cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 61% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · WTI +1.54% · Brent -3.28% · NatGas +12.20%. 61% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +2.91%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.91%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -2.35%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ENPH is the standout at -16.17%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +15.10%, NXT +9.54%, EOSE +7.14%, PWR +6.68%, ARRY +5.01%. Laggards: ENPH -16.17%, SEDG -9.33%, BKR -7.36%, NOV -6.23%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.44% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
